feeds.title: Scottish Rugby Blog
feeds.description: The original Scottish rugby union news and opinion website for Scottish rugby union fans worldwide. Scotland rugby news & opinion written by Scottish Rugby fans for Scottish Rugby fans. Covers mainly pro rugby union in Scotland.

feeds.title: The Offside Line
feeds.description: The first port of call for news at all levels of Scottish Rugby Union, with match reports, features and the latest gossip. The Offside Line was set up by David Barnes with the aim of providing high quality, independent and up-to-date coverage of all aspects of Scottish rugby.

feeds.title: Aristotle Armstrong - Scottish Rugby Philosopher
feeds.description: Aristotle Armstrong is the Scottish Rugby Philosopher, The Truly Independent Commentator on Scottish Rugby, who offers his thoughts on the major issues of the day as they affect the world of Scottish Rugby.

feeds.title: Weegie Rugby - Scotland
feeds.description: Supporting grassroots rugby across West Region in Scotland, with a bit about the Glasgow & Edinburgh pro teams and the Scotland national team.

feeds.title: Scottish Rugby News
feeds.description: Scottish Rugby is the governing body for rugby union in Scotland. Our role is to grow the game and inspire Scotland through rugby in line with our values of respect, leadership, achievement, engagement and enjoyment.

feeds.title: On Top Of The Moon
feeds.description: 'On Top Of The Moon' is a blog by a dedicated fan of Glasgow Warriors, Scotland, and rugby in general who has a fascination with statistics and the insight they can provide into the game. Conflating 'on top of the world' and 'over the moon' he succinctly summed up every Warriors' fans' feelings after a big win!

feeds.title: London Scottish Rugby News
feeds.description: London Scottish Football Club was founded on Wednesday 10th April 1878 at Mackay's Tavern, 3 Water Lane, Ludgate Hill. Since this date there's been a journey which has made it one of the most historic and renowned clubs in the world. London Scottish has had more than 200 internationals come through its ranks with no less than four British and Irish Lions Captains, the same number as Leicester Tigers.

feeds.title: Glasgow Warriors News
feeds.description: Based at Scotstoun Stadium, Glasgow Warriors is one of Scotland's two professional rugby clubs. Based at Scotstoun Stadium, Glasgow Warriors is one of Scotland's two professional rugby clubs.

feeds.title: Edinburgh Rugby
feeds.description: Edinburgh is Scotland's capital rugby club, competing at the forefront of Scottish and European rugby for over 145 years. We represent Edinburgh and the East of Scotland in the United Rugby Championship and Heineken Champions Cup.

feeds.title: Scotland Rugby League News
feeds.description: Scotland Rugby League is the governing body for rugby league in Scotland overseeing development and participation at all levels of the sport. Our aim is to provide opportunities for people of all ages to take part in the game while developing a strong competitive environment to support the development of our international players.

feeds.title: The Edinburgh Rugby Blog by The Burgh Watch
feeds.description: Former Edinburgh Wanderers, Corstorphine, Lothian and Borders Police and The Co-Optimists player. My playing is now much more sedate with Midlothian Walking Rugby. A relatively late convert to supporting Edinburgh Rugby but now dyed in the wool, blue and burnt orange. Here you will find all the news, match reports, stats, and related nonsense about Edinburgh Rugby.
